name: hackl-monorepo
description: Hackl: local-first AI coding agent. Shared core, VS Code extension, and CLI.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:release
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:release && npm run test -w @hackl/core && npm run test -w @hackl/cli && npm run test -w @hackl/server && npm run test -w @hackl/webui && npm run test:coverage -w hackl
scripts.package:vsix: npm run package:vsix -w hackl && cp packages/vscode/*.vsix .
